objective: Take a novice developer from a rough idea or partial implementation to a real deployed application through evidence-driven AAOP route transitions without making the user operate the engineering machinery.

state_contract.write_precondition: Every checkpoint mutation must use the revision returned by the latest reconciled status read; stale revisions are rejected while mutation is serialized by a local OS file lock.
state_contract.authority: Journey state is a resumability checkpoint only. Current repository, runtime, target-environment, and user evidence wins when it conflicts with a saved checkpoint. Completed release evidence is historical and must not satisfy a later release cycle.

entry_conditions: the user has a product/app idea or an existing partial implementation
the desired outcome spans more than one route transition
the user wants the system to continue through implementation and release rather than only provide advice
user_owns: material product decisions that cannot be inferred from evidence
credentials and external-account authorization when required
production-write approval unless an existing explicit policy already grants it
system_owns: technical discovery and stack decisions derived from constraints
journey checkpoint maintenance, resume reconciliation, and stale-write prevention
release-cycle boundaries so old target verification cannot prove a later release
capability/provider selection only after a proven gap
release preflight preparation and rollback planning

gates.goal: Resolve the current situation, the long-horizon observable outcome, hard constraints, and the next evidence-bearing step without assuming the project is greenfield.
exit_evidence: current primary route selected from present evidence
first material uncertainty or immediate blocker

gates.applies_when: No trustworthy existing user-visible slice already provides enough evidence to continue from the current implementation.
gates.skip_when: A trustworthy existing implementation already has a usable slice and the immediate problem belongs to another route.
gates.goal: Define and build the smallest real slice that buys useful learning.
exit_evidence: evidence that at least one material uncertainty was reduced

gates.goal: Establish only the minimum trustworthy project/environment baseline required to continue from the current project state.
exit_evidence: known validation commands or equivalent evidence
saved Journey checkpoint reconciled with current evidence

gates.applies_when: A verified implementation delta remains after intake/project discovery, whether that delta is a feature, defect, recovery task, or another evidence-selected engineering route.
gates.goal: Iterate through the smallest coherent evidence-backed changes under the current Route until the intended release behavior is present.
Prove that the application is a release candidate, not merely locally complete.
Resolve target-environment truth, authorization, current target revision/precondition, blast radius, and rollback before consequential writes.
exit_evidence: current target state or explicit unknown

gates.goal: Revalidate the target immediately before the write, deploy only within authorization, and directly verify the actual target behavior before completion.
exit_evidence: direct target revision/state evidence for the current release cycle
health/smoke/acceptance evidence for the current release cycle

gates.goal: Convert real use/release evidence into the next product or engineering decision without automatically expanding scope. Starting a new implementation cycle explicitly archives the completed release and invalidates its target verification for the new cycle.
exit_evidence: repeatable failure pattern promoted only when justified

route_transition_rules: initial current route is selected by developer-intake from present evidence, not by Journey position
contradictory or untrustworthy repository state -> repo-recovery
deployment/release is the immediate blocker -> release-operations
a route transition must be justified by materially new evidence or a changed blocker classification; lack of progress alone is not a reroute signal
if routes begin to oscillate without new evidence, stop and reclassify the blocker instead of continuing to bounce
after a completed release, new build/fix work starts an explicit next release cycle; previous target verification is archived and cannot satisfy the new cycle
before mutating Journey continuity state, re-read and reconcile the current checkpoint revision; a stale revision must fail rather than overwrite concurrent evidence

capability_policy.default: one capable host-native agent with existing project tools
capability_policy.specialist_condition: specialization, context isolation, safe parallel independence, adversarial review, or a permission boundary materially improves execution
capability_policy.provider_condition: a genuine capability gap remains after native agent, project scripts/tests, Skills, host tools, connected tools, and existing specialists are checked
capability_policy.agent_bundles: optional curated specialist source; never default-install

historical_sources.creating-forward: requirements baseline, task/evidence discipline, authorization boundaries, interruption recovery; archived lineage, not a parallel runtime
historical_sources.solo-dev-autopilot: novice UX, environment/bootstrap, dev loop, verification, review, commit/release preflight, deployment gate; concepts absorbed into AAOP gates rather than copied as a fixed 21-Skill topology
historical_sources.agent-bundles: curated specialist-agent source used only after AAOP justifies specialist composition

completion: a real user-visible application slice for the current release cycle is deployed to the intended target
the deployed target revision/state for the current release cycle is directly verified with target-environment evidence
the intended target acceptance path is proven where practical
the next product decision can be based on real evidence rather than speculative architecture
if direct target verification is blocked, the Journey remains blocked/not-complete and records the exact unblock condition
